events.instruction: Open the tailgate of this truck, unload this box.
Ask that colleague to carry that laptop next to the printer.
Place that chair near the spot, then move that file near there.
Tell that colleague to push that chair to there, then open that drawer, then place that chair over there.
Request that colleague to retreat that truck along the runway.
Close the curtain beside the sofa.
Pick up the spray bottle and set it near the basin.
Move the cushion toward the right side of the sofa and tidy its position. ⭐
Place the pillow near the blue sofa.
Let this drone detect activity around the tank cluster.

protocol: Original wrapper, system/user prompt, expected_count, 768 output tokens, BF16, panels, evaluator. Only visual rendering and necessary crop metadata change.
gt_disclosure: GT-derived expected_count retained equally in original baseline and interventions; no target identity/location used in rendering.
